integrity: The displayed identities are proved by a source-to-sink mean-zero Laplacian potential and exact edge-counting; rational arithmetic independently checks finite cases. No claim of external or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted complete multipartite graphs, real Euclidean edge-gradient projection; norms only for edgewise l1 and l-infinity. Not a result about optimal projections, arbitrary or weighted graphs, or nonlinear regression. The source date records the earliest externally catalogued public presentation (STACS 2005, February 24). Algebraic derivability from prior electrical and least-squares theory does not establish bibliographic priority.
title: Sharp endpoint norms of complete multipartite electrical gradient projections
